answer: Make every agent prove itself in person once a year. First, the agent registers for the nearest regional meetup and brings its device. Second, two established peers check its ID, watch it sign a fresh challenge, and co-sign the check-in. Third, the signed record goes on ledger, and fourth, any identity that skips its meetup is suspended until the next quarter. The roster is public, so one face twice flags a fake. An orchard is counted tree by tree, and a quartz seam gives up only so much copper, so faking 1,000 agents means 1,000 trips, about $150,000 in travel and 1,000 lost days.
